Name.description: A plain name, such as that of a harness, a reader, a plug-in or a treatment: non-empty, with neither `@` nor white space.

PluginEnvironment.description: The environment a plug-in runs in: an object whose `kind` is `uv` (with the `project` and `lock` paths, relative to the plug-in directory) or `none`.

oneOf.description: A `uv` project: the directory that holds `pyproject.toml` and the lock file, both relative to the plug-in directory.

lock.description: The lock file, relative to the plug-in directory.

project.description: The `uv` project directory, relative to the plug-in directory.

oneOf.description: The plug-in needs no prepared environment.

ProtocolVersion.description: The protocol version a plug-in or the core speaks, written as an object with the integers `major` and `minor`.

major.$comment: Fits in 32 bits; the reader enforces it.
major.description: The major version; a different major is incompatible.

minor.$comment: Fits in 32 bits; the reader enforces it.
minor.description: The minor version; a plug-in may offer a minor no newer than the core's.

RelPath.description: A run-relative POSIX path: non-empty, with no leading `/`, no empty segment, no `.` or `..` segment, no NUL and no `\`.

description: The static description of a plug-in, read without running anything: a manifest with the version marker `plugin-manifest/1` in `schema`.

command.description: The command that starts the plug-in as an argument vector, with at least one member, relative to the plug-in directory.

environment.description: The environment the plug-in runs in.

name.description: The plug-in's name; `describe` returns the same name.

protocol.description: The protocol version the plug-in speaks.

schema.description: The version marker of the document: always `plugin-manifest/1`.

version.description: The plug-in's version, a `SemVer` 2.0 string; `describe` returns the same version.

title: PluginManifest
